items.title: Pay settlement amount to avoid lawsuit
items.quote: Überweisen Sie den Vergleichsbetrag bis zum 01.12.2026 auf das Konto IBAN DE88 3704 0044 0532 0881 00, Kontoinhaber M. Beispielmann.
items.computation: The letter states a fixed calendar date for the payment: 01.12.2026 (a Tuesday). This is a private settlement demand from a law firm, not a German authority, so no statutory deemed-delivery or §187/188 BGB period-counting applies — the printed date is itself the deadline. 01.12.2026 is a Tuesday and not a public holiday in NW, so no weekend/holiday shift is needed. The due date is therefore 2026-12-01 as written; allow about one business day earlier for the bank transfer to arrive if paying by SEPA transfer.

warnings: The IBAN printed in the letter (DE88 3704 0044 0532 0881 00) fails the standard IBAN checksum check — do not pay to this account without first verifying the correct IBAN directly with the sender through an independently found contact (not a number/email from this letter).

This is a private 'Abmahnung' (cease-and-desist/settlement demand) from a law firm, not a court judgment or an authority decision — there is no legal obligation to pay the demanded sum merely because the letter says so, and no Rechtsbehelfsbelehrung is given because none applies; get independent legal advice (e.g. a Verbraucherzentrale or a lawyer specialising in Abmahnungen) before paying or ignoring it.

The letter uses pressure language ('letzte außergerichtliche Gelegenheit') and offers to waive a cease-and-desist declaration (Unterlassungserklärung) if paid quickly, which is unusual and a pattern seen in both legitimate and fraudulent mass file-sharing Abmahnungen — verify the firm's identity, the cited case reference, and the claim itself before transferring any money.

The underlying claim (an alleged copyright infringement via a file-sharing network) is asserted only by the sender; no evidence, court order or detailed infringement log is included in the letter itself.
